in_marathi.name: Charul
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beautiful, lovely, precious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Charu' which means 'that which is beautiful, lovely or precious'. This name is often given to girls born under the moon's influence, symbolizing the gentle, nurturing and joyful nature of the moon.
